Help

Support

Find answers to the most common questions about Don’t Break Fast below.

Notifications are not arriving

Open iPhone Settings, select Notifications, then Don’t Break Fast, and confirm that notifications are allowed. Focus modes and Scheduled Summary can delay ordinary notifications.

A Live Activity disappeared

iOS limits how long one Live Activity can remain active. Its disappearance does not end your fast; the timer and widgets continue to reflect the saved fast.

A widget looks out of date

Open Don’t Break Fast once to refresh its shared state. Widget timing and refresh frequency are ultimately controlled by iOS.

How do I delete my data?

In Don’t Break Fast, open Settings and choose Delete All History. You can also delete the app to remove its locally stored data, subject to your device and backup settings.

Do I need an account?

No. Don’t Break Fast has no account and keeps its history locally on your device.

System requirements

Don’t Break Fast requires an iPhone running iOS 26 or later.

Still need help?

For help, feedback or a feature request, email dontbreakfast@nsscode.com. Please include your iPhone model, iOS version and a short description of what happened. Do not include sensitive health information.
